hero.lead: Animora brings everything on your farm into one mobile app: animal records, health and vaccines, milk yield, breeding calendar, finance and your team.
hero.note: Coming to iOS and Android. You will be able to start with the Free plan.

values.title: Everything in one place
values.text: One tidy record instead of notebooks, diaries and spreadsheets.

values.title: Never miss a task
values.text: Timely reminders for vaccines, checks and births.

values.title: Work as a team
values.text: Your workers and your vet work on the same records.

features.title: Everything your farm needs
features.text: Animora helps you follow the daily operation of your farm and the biological cycle of your animals together.

items.title: Animal records
items.text: An ID card for every animal with ear tag number, species, breed, birth date, parents and group. Add photos and find any animal in seconds.

items.title: Health, vaccines and treatments
items.text: Vaccination schedules, examinations, diagnoses and treatments, together with medicines and withdrawal periods.

items.title: Milk production
items.text: Record milkings per animal or per herd; follow daily and weekly yield and your top producers.

items.title: Breeding and pregnancy
items.text: Heat, insemination, pregnancy checks, dry-off and calving events; expected calving dates are calculated automatically.

items.title: Calendar and reminders
items.text: See upcoming vaccinations, checks and births in one calendar and get notified on time.

items.title: Finance
items.text: Track income and expenses by category and see profitability for your farm and for each animal.

items.title: Feed and rations
items.text: Use the feed library and ration calculator to build a feeding plan for each group.

items.title: Inventory
items.text: Keep track of feed, medicine and supply stock and spot low items in time.

items.title: Reports and export
items.text: Export herd, health, milk and finance reports as PDF or Excel and share them.

items.title: Team management
items.text: Invite workers and partners and give each person the permissions their role needs.

items.title: Veterinarian mode
items.text: Your veterinarian can join your farm and send examinations, diagnoses and treatment plans directly in the app.

items.title: Paddock Plan
items.text: Map your barns and paddocks and see where every animal is at a glance.

spotlight.title: Your daily work, a few taps away
spotlight.text: Screens are designed for quick use in the field: large touch targets, clear numbers and meaningful colours.

items.alt: Animal profile screen: ear tag, breed, lactation day and a withdrawal warning
items.title: Every animal’s full history on one screen
items.text: Ear tag, breed and lactation day at the top, with withdrawal warnings right below. Health history, milk records, pedigree and notes are one tap away.
points: Health and breeding data in separate tabs

items.alt: Health dashboard: active treatments, pending vaccines and withdrawal alerts
items.title: Treatments, vaccines and withdrawal alerts
items.text: See active treatments, pending vaccines and animals whose milk must be withheld at a glance. Log vaccinations and follow protocols from the same dashboard.

items.alt: Milk production screen: total milk, yield per cow and top producers
items.title: Daily yield and top producers
items.text: Record milkings per animal or for the whole herd; follow total milk, average per cow and the number of milking cows, daily or weekly.

items.alt: Finance screen: income, expense, net profit and cash flow chart
items.title: Income, expenses and cash flow
items.text: Record income and expenses by category, follow net profit by week, month or year and see profitability per animal.

screens.title: Simple screens, clear information
screens.text: In the field, in the barn or in the office, get to what you need in a few taps.

soon.text: We are working on sensor integration for barn conditions and animal health. This feature is not available yet; we will announce it here when it is ready.

items.a: Animora is built for cattle and buffalo as well as sheep and goat operations. You can track animals individually or in groups.

items.q: When will the app be available?
items.a: Animora is being prepared for launch. The store buttons on this page will be activated once the iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play) versions are published.

items.q: Can I use it for free?
items.a: Yes. The Free plan covers basic animal records, viewing health records and limited calendar use for small herds. Upgrade to Basic or Pro when you need more.

items.q: How are subscriptions billed and cancelled?
items.a: Paid plans are purchased through your App Store or Google Play account and renew automatically at the end of each period. You can cancel any time in your store account settings; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period.

items.q: Can my team and my vet use it too?
items.a: Yes. Invite your workers and assign permissions by role. Veterinarian mode lets your vet join your farm and record examinations and treatments directly.
Your data is transferred over encrypted connections (HTTPS) and is only accessible to you and the team members you authorise. See our Privacy Policy for details.

items.q: Can I sign in with my phone number?
items.a: Yes. When you enter your phone number, a one-time verification code is sent as a WhatsApp message from Appouse’s WhatsApp business line, not by SMS, so WhatsApp must be installed on that number. The code is valid for 5 minutes.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: In the app go to Settings → Delete Account. If you cannot access the app, use the email option on the Account and Data Deletion page.
